'''Sosear Latta''' was an [[alien]] that was in the [[Canto Bight]] [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|casino]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of the film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. As [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']] carries on immediately from the events of ''The Force Awakens'', it can be assumed to take place in the same [[Standard year|year]].</ref> Sosear had [[Color|black]] [[eye]]s and gray [[hair]].<ref name="TLJVD" />
